title: Council: Wave 7 Post-Reset Priorities
summary: Priority stack after rate limit hit during Wave 6 interrupted Bobby and Mom.
content:
Council Brief -- Wave 7 Post-Reset Priorities

Date: 2026-03-12 Agents present: All (quick council) Question: Rate limit hit during Wave 6. Bobby's /v2 rebuild and Mom's tracking didn't complete. What's the priority stack now?

State of Play

Wave 6 completed (8 of 10 agents):

  • Elmo: /v2 teardown DONE (FAIL verdict, 3 ship blockers, 50+ sub-16px)
  • Steffen: 3 specs shipped (v2 feel refinement, brand page v4, consistency scan)
  • Colton: Shared SiteNav + SiteFooter shipped (bb2f050), applied to 4 pages
  • Steve: Supabase schema + migration SQL ready
  • Elon: Relay optimization + v2 perf guide written
  • Jacob: 3 partnership emails + phone script + AZ ROC prep
  • Paige: Health scan #8 (3 RED, 3 ORANGE, 1 YELLOW)
  • Alex: 3 Ambition LinkedIn posts drafted

Wave 6 failed (hit token limit):

  • Bobby: /v2 rebuild -- did NOT complete. Zero code written.
  • Mom: Tracking updates -- did NOT complete. Files are stale.

Bobby now has everything he needs:

  • Elmo's teardown: 3 ship blockers (hero clips mobile, stats overflow, construction slide empty) + 50+ sub-16px
  • Steffen's feel refinement: Framer Motion transition model, progress bar redesign, per-slide stagger choreography
  • Steffen's original 990-line design spec
  • Elon's performance guide (video preloading, lazy loading, Lighthouse targets)

New Patrik directives from this session:

  1. /v2 is clunky, audit is the bible, room for visual creativity
  2. Brand page needs v4 update + template kit expansion
  3. Every webpage connected to the system (agent updates = site updates)
  4. All research docs become briefs with webpages (auto-publish pipeline)

Wave 7 Missions

  1. Bobby: /v2 rebuild. THE mission. Framer Motion, fix all 3 Elmo blockers, match audit feel. Has Steffen's spec + Elmo's teardown + Elon's perf guide.
  2. Mom: Update ALL tracking files (punch-list, priorities, HANDOFF, push-list) with Wave 5-6 results. Mark BFG as DONE. Update agent statuses.
  3. Elmo: QA Colton's shared SiteNav + SiteFooter across /ideas, /briefs, /book, /case-study.
  4. Colton: Fix any Elmo findings from shared component QA. Then: fix font-black italic spread (16+ instances per Steffen's scan).
  5. Steffen: Brand page v4 build spec is done. Continue brand consistency monitoring. If Bobby's /v2 starts landing, do a live review.
  6. Jacob: AZ ROC segmentation prep is done. Continue refining partnership approach. Waiting on Patrik's draft review + CSV download.
  7. Elon: Relay speed (reduce outbox poll to 0.5s). Fix RAG index TCC permission issue.
  8. Alex: Ambition posts are drafted. Prep the auto-publish pipeline concept (how agent .md files get frontmatter and auto-appear on site).
  9. Steve: Supabase schema is done. Write the auto-publish architecture spec (how agent output -> frontmatter -> /briefs page -> individual page).
  10. Paige: Done for this cycle. Results logged.

Decision

Bobby rebuilds /v2. Everything else supports that or moves independently. No agent idles except Tony (Docker blocked) and Cleo (needs Patrik's Resolve session).
